name: Pasutakan

desc: One of the best-known [[Japan#Noodles

name: Chikuyōtei

name: Ginza Cafe Paulista
desc: One of the oldest cafes in Japan and a favorite of John Lennon and Yoko Ono, the Paulista opened in 1909 with beans imported directly from Santos, Brazil.

name: Three Hundred Bar

desc: Both bars have a mixed foreign and Japanese clientele.

desc: The original and not quite as over-the-top (or expensive) as some of the competition. A long line can form on weekends.

name: Bar Arara

name: Sushizanmai

desc: A popular beef rice bowl chain.

desc: A long-established pork cutlet store.

name: Gyosai Yura
desc: Japanese style pub.

name: Kofuku Ryōri Nakamoto
desc: Japanese style pub.

name: Manraien
desc: Many celebrities frequently visit Chinese cuisine. However, lunch is for commoners.

desc: Music bar, Showa popular song.

name: HUB
desc: An English-style pub with locations throughout Japan.

name: Paul

name: Yoshinoya
desc: Fast food chain with Japanese style food.

price: Pints of beer are around ¥900, half

desc: This restaurant serves standard Japanese izakaya fare.

name: Nakazaki

name: Kitchin Naoki
desc: An upscale Western restaurant.

name: Jinenbo

name: Dropkick

name: RAJ
